quizGuardRationale: Author judgments for independent assessment: direct ordinary-meaning/actual-label overlap; symmetric, nontransitive. No baseline declaration changes. No nonexistent word is used as a target.

産地 guards native-origin 原産, birthplace/native-place uses on 出身/故郷/生まれ and source/origin 元. 原産's actual provenance and dictionary habitat overlap is assessed directly, not inferred through other guards; not every land/place word is an origin synonym.
サンプル guards example/specimen/model senses on 例/例え/典型/個体/代表. A sample need not be typical, but their actual displayed exemplar/specimen answers can overlap; no generic product or research clique.
山林 guards 林/森 and 山's actual forest sense, and 土地/地 under forest land. Not a tree-height or altitude taxonomy.
仕上がる guards 完成/完了 and completion uses on できる/終わる/終える/済む/済ませる/仕舞い/上がる/終わり, with transitivity differences explained rather than used as a loophole for ambiguous English completion labels.
シーズン guards 季節/時期 for seasonal/activity periods; 四季 names the collective set, not one season. シーツ has no existing シート article to guard; plain-text contrast remains sourced.
寺院 guards 寺 and its independently supported broader Christian religious-building overlap with 教会; no automatic Shinto-shrine/theme clique.
自衛 guards direct defending/protecting uses on 守る/防ぐ; not every military or legal noun. 塩辛い guards 辛い's actual salty sense and 塩's salt label, without denying spicy/salty distinctions.
司会 guards actual chairperson 議長, not every participant, 会議 gathering or entertainment identity.
四角 and 四角い directly guard the same shape; declaration on both is redundant but harmless. Bare-corner 角 and whole triangular 三角 are not shape synonyms.
時間割 guards 予定 and the separate timetable family of ダイヤ, not its diamond family or the mere duration 時間.
敷地 guards directly applicable land/site/place/grounds labels on 土地/地/所/場所/場/現場/校庭/キャンパス. A school 学校 and a garden 庭 are not automatically names of the plot or premises as such.
至急 guards direct urgent/prompt/immediate meanings on 急/急ぐ/すぐに/直ちに/早速/さっさと/早い/急に/はきはき. No blanket brisk-motion/hurrying-on-the-run clique.

敷く independently guards 置く/並べる under laying out, 広がる under the formal intransitive spreading sense, and 押さえる under controlling/pinning. 覆う/カバー/被せる focus on over-covering, not automatically the ordinary laying-underneath answer; no broad covering clique.
茂る guards directly applicable grow/flourish/dense labels on 伸びる/育つ/栄える/密/ぎっしり. 豊か/豊富/豪華/贅沢/高級 are not inferred synonyms from the raw luxurious gloss. No luxury clique.

Existing しーん retains all baseline teaching, identity, title, image and [静か, 黙る] declarations, with only sourced jlpt 2 added. Its existing しいん alias and complete-silence meaning satisfy this source row; this is metadata-enriched reuse, not wholly unchanged reuse.
sourceAccessLimits: Nineteen new articles and one metadata-enriched reuse cover N2:642-N2:661. Named community-list membership is not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Seven newly tracked primary N2 reciprocal pairs across six kanji files: 林/山林, 寺/寺院, 塩/塩辛い, 辛/塩辛い, 角/四角, 角/四角い and 季/四季. All existing component reading rows preserved.
Missing primary 衛/司/敷/至/茂 remain metadata or plain text; no missing kanji/stroke articles fabricated. Kana-primary しあさって has no invented primary written components.

Raw source spelling/reading/gloss/entry remain separate from selected teaching. Source sporting-season, chairmanship and luxurious glosses do not erase current secondary senses or license unrelated meanings. Public extra senses do not receive invented JMdict indices.
Nineteen public containers yielded positive receipts. Observations are original concise paraphrases, not copied dictionary bodies or a frequency/collocation survey.

No executed app quiz draws, measured frequency, native-speaker certification or exhaustive baseline rereview. Initial derivative removes only quizGuardRationale; remaining mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess.
